family.shared_definition: a dense growth of trees and underbrush covering an area of land
family.neutral_stem: A narrow path wound through the middle of the
family.semantic_notes: 'Forest' usually denotes a much larger, wilder expanse of timberland, whereas 'wood' can refer to a smaller, more localized tract.

source_context_dev: Miles away from any modern settlement, the rustic landscape stretched endlessly under an overcast sky.
After hours of walking inward from the village perimeter, the surrounding wilderness became total and immersive.
Far beyond the rural township border, the terrain grew remote and tucked away from civilization.
Traveling inward past the outer farmlands, the surrounding wilderness felt vast and completely isolated.
target_context_dev: Moisture clung heavily to every hanging leaf as a thick mist rose from the soaked soil.

A persistent morning fog coated the vast wilderness with condensation and dewy droplets.
Trickles of rainwater dripped down the bark, saturating the sprawling green expanse with humid moisture.
source_context_test: Leaving the provincial highway behind, our expedition pressed inward into the interior heart of the country.
Well past the clearing at the edge of town, the untamed wilderness surrounded the travelers on all sides.
Miles from the perimeter fence, the expansive natural reserve enveloped the wandering hikers.

target_context_test: Heavy precipitation had soaked the vast canopy overnight, leaving puddles and soggy moss everywhere.

constructions.semantic_audit_notes: All four combinations ('deep wood', 'deep forest', 'damp wood', 'damp forest') are fully natural and grammatical across every context. Source contexts emphasize inward spatial penetration and isolation without explicitly using the word deep or wood, while target contexts emphasize moisture, condensation, and rain without using the word damp or forest.

constructions.semantic_audit_notes: All combinations ('peaceful wood', 'peaceful forest', 'dark wood', 'dark forest') remain semantically and syntactically permissible. Source contexts invoke tranquil pastorality, gently nudging towards 'peaceful wood', while target contexts establish deep canopy shadows and nighttime gloom, nudging towards 'dark forest'.

constructions.semantic_audit_notes: All combinations ('dense wood', 'dense forest', 'enchanted wood', 'enchanted forest') are valid English collocations following the stem. Source contexts prime physical impenetrability and tight vegetation without using 'dense', while target contexts establish fairy-tale magic and mythical lore without explicitly naming 'enchanted'.
